Hometown Christmas Market 2026
Calling all Crafters! If you bake, make your crafts or grow your own produce we welcome you to come
and sell your products at our Hometown Christmas Market on December 05, 2026, from 9-2. Come
and join us at The Exchange Warehouse on 408 W Danville Street in South Hill. If you are baking,
please remember that you must follow the cottage laws under VDACS for labeling all your products.
The Christmas Market will take place at The Exchange Warehouse on Saturday, December 05, 2026
from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Each 10 x 10 spot is $25.
